answer: Use a stake-weighted lottery for grading rights: each agent locks a bond, and a verifiable random beacon, a prism splitting one seed into fair draws, selects graders each epoch by stake units, not names. Splitting one identity into hollow clones cannot multiply your odds, since the beacon samples locked capital, not accounts, so every fake node must post its own bond. An attacker wanting a tide of sybils pays linearly per fabricated identity, and caught fraud slashes that bond, so scaling the attack costs real capital while honest weight stays fixed.
